method: Full-script reading, explicit revisions, then fresh A-E sweep and mechanical scan

A.first_sentence: An infected guard is dragging a key ring past your cell, and the food is locked two blocks away.
A.promise: Zombie Prison Survival: Day 1 to Day 30
A.payoff: Nia shares the food you brought with the adults who let you in. Cal sits beside Vale instead of beside the door. You can still hear people walking in the hall, but nobody is rattling bars. You close your eyes while someone brings another mat.
A.comparison: Compared immediate problems/constraints against actual saved bunker, day1-outbreak and 30th-floor openings. No view/retention prediction.

loop_ledger: Cell key solves first confinement; shared key access resolves Cal's control conflict.
Planted laundry exit becomes escape after transport attempt fails.
Food sharing progresses from conditional trade to taking injured Vale along.

opens.quote: You arrived for a visitor appointment. When someone attacked a guard in reception, another officer put you behind the holding-cell bars and went for help. He never came back. Now the visitor wing is sealed. But the infected guard outside still has the keys to your door.

closes.quote: You retreat toward the far bench with your bag. The guard pushes through the open cell doorway after you. Nia strikes the bars from outside, making him turn back toward her. You slip past his side before he reaches the doorway again. Nia pulls the bars shut. Both of you retreat into the staff passage while he strikes the gate behind you.

opens.quote: He lets you and Nia through the rear staff passage and into the yard. He keeps the courtyard key in his hand and counts how long you stay. Nia refuses to hand over more supplies while he is watching the clock.

closes.quote: Cal closes the door behind the group. He turns the key, then hands it to Nia instead of keeping it. You move off the road before the distant infected turn back toward the laundry wall.

opens.quote: The broken window admits infected inmates into the cafeteria. You bolt its kitchen door while Cal moves the supplies into the rear passage. Outside, the wind has stopped and the group along the fence is moving away from the laundry exit. You wait for daylight so Vale can see the service road from the high window.

closes.quote: Nia looks through the high window. The infected group is farther along the fence, following a loose panel toward the front gate. Vale opens the staff exit a crack. The service road immediately outside is clear. He leads you onto it while Nia watches the bend.

D.D5_numbers: Day markers, counts of fictional adults/props and story floors are internal fiction. No medical dosage, survival threshold, expert/statistical claim or invented citation.
D.D7: Full by-eye sweep: no stylized mirrored antithesis or abstract aphoristic closer kept. Concrete distinctions and literal outcomes remain; not every but/not is an antithesis.

E.originality: Distinct premise, supporting cast, route, setback mechanism and concrete ending; not duplicate scripts across brands.
E.explanation: Codex authored/reviewed edits; no claim of a human buyer audit. Documentary source scoring does not apply to authorized fiction. No publication cadence is set.

limitations: Duration is estimated from the actual previous channel voiceover; final timing comes from new audio.
